```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(lme4)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}

#NDS data

folder_path <- "datasets/NDS_dataset"

NDS_data <- read.csv("a_class_dataset.csv", sep = ";", header = TRUE)

head(data)
str(data)

clean_NDS <- NDS_data %>%
  filter(
    MN_class %in% c("a", "e", "doubl a/e"),
    present_tense_r %in% c("YES", "NO"),
    Cell %in% c("present", "preterit", "supine")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    class_label = case_when(
      MN_class == "a"         ~ "a-class",
      MN_class == "e"         ~ "e-class",
      MN_class == "doubl a/e" ~ "a/e doublet"
    ),
    homophony_locality = ifelse(present_tense_r == "NO", "Lost -r", "Retained -r")
  )

clean_NDS %>%
  distinct(Locality, homophony_locality) %>%  
  count(homophony_locality, name = "n_localities")

```


```{r}
#visualizations of data for the NDS dataset

# distribution of a/e by cell
ggplot(clean_NDS, aes(x = factor(Cell, levels = c("present", "preterit", "supine")), fill = class_label)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", width = 0.6, colour = "black") +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count",
    aes(label = ..count..),
    position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 4,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("a-class" = "#0072B2", "e-class" = "#2F2F2F", "a/e doublet" = "#BDBDBD")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Cell", y = "Percentage of attested forms", fill = "Inflectional class") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 12),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "right")


#Distribution per homophonous and non-homophonous localities

ggplot(clean_NDS, aes(x = homophony_locality, fill = class_label)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", width = 0.6, colour = "black") +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count",
    aes(label = ..count..),
    position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 4,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("a-class" = "#0072B2", "e-class" = "#2F2F2F", "a/e doublet" = "#BDBDBD")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Homophony status", y = "Percentage of attested forms", fill = "Inflectional class") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 12),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "right")
```

```{r}

#The glists data
directory_path <- "datasets/G_lists_dataset"

#loading the data
Glists_data <- list.files(directory_path, pattern = "*.csv", full.names = TRUE)


combined_data_Glists <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Glists_data, function(file) {
  read_delim(file, delim = ";", locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"))
}))

str(combined_data_Glists)

#removing NA rows in Dialect
cleaned_data_Glists <- combined_data_Glists %>% filter(!is.na(Dialect))

#removing all irrelevant verbs - keeping only sources G14, unless hist_status is a, and all other sources only if hist_status is a
filtered_data_G <- cleaned_data_Glists %>%
  filter(
    (Source == "G14" & Hist_status %in% c("loan", "non", "a")) |
    (Source != "G14" & Hist_status == "a")
  )
#now i need to exclude any verbs that have other inflections, like shortV or strong
lexemes_to_remove <- c("hoeya", "nya", "skya", "snoe", "bia", "fria", "spe", "tae", "skoda", "hauga", "skrika") 

clean_data_G <- filtered_data_G %>%
  filter(!(Lexeme %in% lexemes_to_remove))

#further cleaning, keeping only relevant values, cells etc
clean_data_G <- clean_data_G %>%
  filter(
    MN_class %in% c("a", "e", "a/e"),
    present_r %in% c("YES", "NO"),
    Cell %in% c("pres", "pret", "sup")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    class_label = case_when(
      MN_class == "a"         ~ "a-class",
      MN_class == "e"         ~ "e-class",
      MN_class == "a/e" ~ "a/e doublet"
    ),
    homophony_locality = ifelse(present_r == "NO", "Lost -r", "Retained -r")
  )


clean_data_G %>%
  distinct(Dialect, homophony_locality) %>%   # one row per locality + status
  count(homophony_locality, name = "n_localities")



```

```{r}
#statistical analysis of NDS and g-lists dataset together

NDS_renamed <- clean_NDS %>%
  rename(
    "present_r" = "present_tense_r",
  ) %>%
  rename(
    "Dialect" = "Locality",
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Cell = fct_recode(
      Cell,
      "pres" = "present",
      "pret" = "preterit",
      "sup" = "supine"
    ),
    MN_class = fct_recode(
      MN_class,
      "a/e" = "doubl a/e"
    )
  )

clean_data_G_filtered <- clean_data_G %>%
  filter(Source != "NDS")

clean_data_G_analysis <- clean_data_G_filtered %>%
  select(
    Lexeme,
    Cell,
    Dialect,        
    MN_class,
    present_r
  )

clean_data_NDS_analysis <- NDS_renamed %>%
  select(
    Lexeme,
    Cell,
    Dialect,        
    MN_class,
    present_r
  )

clean_data_G_analysis <- clean_data_G_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    MN_class  = as.factor(MN_class),
    Cell      = as.factor(Cell),
    present_r = as.factor(present_r),
    Dialect   = as.factor(Dialect),
    Lexeme    = as.factor(Lexeme)
  )

clean_data_NDS_analysis <- clean_data_NDS_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    MN_class  = as.factor(MN_class),
    Cell      = as.factor(Cell),
    present_r = as.factor(present_r),
    Dialect   = as.factor(Dialect),
    Lexeme    = as.factor(Lexeme)
  )

joined_NDS_G_data <- bind_rows(
  clean_data_NDS_analysis,
  clean_data_G_analysis
)

joined_NDS_G_data <- joined_NDS_G_data %>%
  mutate(
    Cell = relevel(Cell, ref = "pret") #set preterit as reference level, since i am interested in comparing the pret-sup
  )

joined_NDS_G_data <- joined_NDS_G_data %>%
  mutate(
    MN_class = fct_recode(MN_class, "e" = "a/e")
  )

model_hom <- glmer(MN_class ~ present_r + Cell + (1 | Dialect) + (1 | Lexeme),
               data = joined_NDS_G_data,
               family = binomial)

summary(model_hom)

#now repeat only for dialect points with homophony

joined_NDS_G_data_hom <- filter(joined_NDS_G_data, present_r == "NO")

model_hom_only <- glmer(MN_class ~ Cell + (1 | Dialect) + (1 | Lexeme),
               data = joined_NDS_G_data_hom,
               family = binomial)

summary(model_hom_only)

#

model_hom_check <- glmer(
  MN_class ~ present_r * Cell + (1 | Dialect) + (1 | Lexeme),
  data   = joined_NDS_G_data,
  family = binomial
)

summary(model_hom_check)
```



```{r}
#analysis of the homophony dataset

setwd("datasets")

HA_data <- read.csv("homophony_dataset.csv", sep = ";", header = TRUE)

#EDA: how many localities, municipalities and dialect areas in dataset?

HA_data %>%
  summarise(
    n_localities     = n_distinct(Locality[!is.na(H_general)]),
    n_municipalities = n_distinct(Municipality),
    n_dialect_areas  = n_distinct(Traditional_dialect_area)
  )

HA_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(H_general), H_general != "NA") %>%
  group_by(Traditional_dialect_area) %>%
  summarise(
    n_localities     = n_distinct(Locality),
    n_municipalities = n_distinct(Municipality),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


#examining western dialects for pres-pret homophony first
#filter
western_d <- HA_data %>%
  filter(General_dialect_area == "Western")

locality_status_West <- western_d %>%
  arrange(Traditional_dialect_area, Municipality, Locality) %>%         
  group_by(Traditional_dialect_area, Municipality, Locality) %>%
  summarise(
    r_status = first(na.omit(r_status)),
    homophony = first(na.omit(H_general)),
    .groups = "drop")


#now looking into homophony
#assign municipalities a status
municipality_homophony_class <- locality_status_West %>%
  filter(!is.na(homophony)) %>%
  group_by(Municipality, Traditional_dialect_area) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total_localities = n(),
    n_known = sum(homophony %in% c("yes", "no", "yes/no")),   # yes, no, or yes/no count as known
    n_yes = sum(homophony == "yes" | homophony == "yes/no", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_no  = sum(homophony == "no"  | homophony == "yes/no", na.rm = TRUE),
    muni_status = case_when(
      n_known == 0               ~ NA_character_,
      n_yes > 0 & n_no == 0      ~ "homophonous",
      n_no > 0  & n_yes == 0     ~ "non-homophonous",
      n_yes > 0 & n_no > 0       ~ "mixed"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(muni_status)) 

#download
library(writexl)
writexl::write_xlsx(municipality_homophony_class, "municipality_homophony_class.xlsx")

#overall counts
counts_by_area_muni_hom_West <- municipality_homophony_class %>%
  group_by(Traditional_dialect_area, muni_status) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = muni_status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

print(counts_by_area_muni_hom_West)

#totals

total_by_status <- municipality_homophony_class %>%
  count(muni_status, name = "n")
total_by_status


#looking into the loss of -r in the present tense as an explanation of why there is or there is no homophony
#per municipality (=localities within a municipality taken together)

municipality_r_class <- locality_status_West %>%
  # keep only localities with a non-NA r_status
  filter(!is.na(r_status)) %>%
  group_by(Municipality, Traditional_dialect_area) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total_localities = n(),
    # count localities that indicate lost (includes "lost" and "lost/retained")
    n_lost = sum(r_status == "lost" | r_status == "lost/retained"),
    # count localities that indicate retained (includes "retained" and "lost/retained")
    n_retained = sum(r_status == "retained" | r_status == "lost/retained"),
    muni_r_status = case_when(
      n_lost > 0 & n_retained == 0 ~ "lost",
      n_retained > 0 & n_lost == 0 ~ "retained",
      n_lost > 0 & n_retained > 0  ~ "mixed"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(muni_r_status)) 

counts_by_area_muni_r_West <- municipality_r_class %>%
  group_by(Traditional_dialect_area, muni_r_status) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from =muni_r_status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

print(counts_by_area_muni_r_West)




```


```{r}
#plotting the western data

muni_counts_hom_West <- municipality_homophony_class %>%
  count(Traditional_dialect_area, muni_status, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(Traditional_dialect_area) %>%
  mutate(
    total_by_area = sum(n),
    pct_within_area = n / total_by_area,             # proportion (0-1) for plotting
    label = paste0(n, " (", percent(pct_within_area, accuracy = 1), ")")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

writexl::write_xlsx(muni_counts_hom_West, "muni_counts_hom_West.xlsx")

muni_counts_hom_West <- muni_counts_hom_West %>%
  mutate(
    Traditional_dialect_area_eng = case_when(
      grepl("^Nordnorsk$", Traditional_dialect_area) ~ "North Nw",
      grepl("^Nordvestlandsk$", Traditional_dialect_area) ~ "Northwestern Nw",
      grepl("^S.rlandsk$", Traditional_dialect_area) ~ "Southern Nw",     
      grepl("^S.rlandsk/S.rvestlandsk$", Traditional_dialect_area) ~ "Southern/Southwestern Nw",
      grepl("^S.rvestlandsk$", Traditional_dialect_area) ~ "Southwestern Nw"
    )
  )

ggplot(muni_counts_hom_West, aes(x = Traditional_dialect_area_eng, y = pct_within_area, fill = muni_status)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 3.5, color = "white") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("homophonous" = "#0072B2", "non-homophonous" = "#BDBDBD", "mixed" = "#2F2F2F"),
    labels = c(
    "homophonous"     = "homophony",
    "non-homophonous" = "no homophony",
    "mixed"           = "mixed evidence"
  )
  ) +
  labs(x = "Dialect area or subdivision (Western dialects)", y = "Percentage of municipalities",
       fill = "Present-preterit homophony") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )


```

```{r}
  summarise(

municipality_homophony_class_ov_East <- locality_status_East_ov %>%

  group_by(Municipality, Traditional_dialect_area) %>%
  summarise(

    n_yes = sum(homophony_ov == "yes" | homophony_ov == "yes/no", na.rm = TRUE),

    ),

counts_by_area_municipality_homophony_class_ov_East <- municipality_homophony_class_ov_East %>%

  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = muni_status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

print(counts_by_area_municipality_homophony_class_ov_East)


#creating a third panel which will show how homophony distributes over eastern dialects, across a-class and in only one of the categories, reusing data from above

vb <- municipality_homophony_class_vb_East %>%
  select(Municipality, Traditional_dialect_area, muni_status_vb = muni_status)

ov <- municipality_homophony_class_ov_East %>%
  select(Municipality, Traditional_dialect_area, muni_status_ov = muni_status)

#joining vb and ov verbs, with all the data
muni_hom_combined_all <- full_join(vb, ov, by = c("Municipality", "Traditional_dialect_area"))

#i have chosen to stick to "secure" evidence, so only municipalities that have a status in both ov and vb verbs here
muni_all <- full_join(vb, ov, by = c("Municipality", "Traditional_dialect_area")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(muni_status_vb) & !is.na(muni_status_ov))

muni_all <- muni_all %>%
  mutate(
    combined = case_when(
      muni_status_vb == "mixed" | muni_status_ov == "mixed" ~ "mixed",
      muni_status_vb == "homophonous" & muni_status_ov == "homophonous" ~ "across_a_class",
      muni_status_ov == "homophonous" & muni_status_vb == "non-homophonous" ~ "overweight_only",
      muni_status_vb == "homophonous" & muni_status_ov == "non-homophonous" ~ "VB_only",
      muni_status_vb == "non-homophonous" & muni_status_ov == "non-homophonous" ~ "none",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    )
  )

muni_all %>%
  count(Traditional_dialect_area, combined) %>%
  group_by(Traditional_dialect_area) %>%
  mutate(
    area_total = sum(n),
    prop       = n / area_total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#download
writexl::write_xlsx(muni_all, "muni_all.xlsx")

#total overview
counts <- muni_all %>% count(combined) %>% mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n))
print(counts)

    n_lost = sum(r_status == "lost" | r_status == "lost/retained"),
    # count localities that indicate retained (includes "retained" and "lost/retained")
    n_retained = sum(r_status == "retained" | r_status == "lost/retained"),

    ),

  ) %>%

counts_by_area_muni_r_East <- municipality_r_class_East %>%
```

```{r}
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 3.5, color = "white") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("across_a_class" = "#0072B2", "VB_only" = "#BDBDBD",
               "mixed" = "grey32", "none" = "black"),
    labels = c(
    "across_a_class"     = "homophony in all a-class verbs",
    "VB_only" = "homophony in vowel balance verbs only",
    "none" = "no homophony",
    "mixed"           = "mixed evidence"
  )
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = c("Austlandsk", "Austlandsk/Midlandsk", "Midlandsk", "Tr\u00F8ndsk"),
    labels = c("East Nw", "East/Midland Nw", "Midland Nw", "Tr\u00F8ndelag Nw")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Dialect area (Eastern dialects)", y = "Percentage of municipalities",
       fill = "Present-preterit homophony") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )


```
